articles.title: Evonik (XTRA:EVK) Stock Could Be Overvalued As Bid Talks End
articles.summary: Evonik Industries has delivered a strong 49.8% gain over the past year, and with the BASF takeover proposal now off the table, investors are left asking how well the current share price lines up with the group’s earnings power. articles.title: Evonik Shares Tumble After BASF Ends Takeover Efforts
articles.summary: German chemicals giant BASF dropped its efforts to acquire Evonik Industries, abandoning a deal that could have exceeded $12 billion and sending shares in the target company sharply lower.

articles.title: Evonik shares rise on report BASF prepares renewed takeover offer
articles.summary: Investing.com -- BASF SE NA O.N. (ETR:BASFn) is canvassing German lawmakers and key institutional stakeholders to determine what concessions are required to secure backing for a renewed takeover bid for domestic chemical peer Evonik Industries AG (ETR:EVKn), according to reporting from Bloomberg News. The outreach signals that the chemical giant is actively preparing to return with an improved proposal within days after Evonik rebuffed an earlier offer exceeding €11 billion ($12.1 billion).

articles.title: BASF proposes takeover of German chemical rival Evonik, Financial Times reports
articles.summary: Investing.com -- BASF SE NA O.N. (ETR:BASFn) has submitted a takeover proposal to German rival Evonik Industries AG (ETR:EVKn), according to reporting from the Financial Times, marking an ambitious push by the world’s largest chemicals group to consolidate a struggling European sector. The Ludwigshafen-based chemical giant recently approached both Evonik management and its primary shareholder, the RAG-Stiftung foundation, to present the potential combination.
